answer: The harbour master keeps a book, and no ship leaves until its name is written there in his own hand. Proof of observatory star chart via transit log is the book: a chart the astronomer draws only after 12 star transits are timed, each timed against the same pendulum clock. The zephyr is the first entry, written when the ship was built; the inlet is the second, written when it first sailed. A cheat must forge 17 entries and build 17 false ships, and the ledge still shows no hull in the water.
